notes.title: The Afterhours Update
notes.notes:
- Added a whole new room for you to enjoy
- Added music visualizers that respond to your music
- A couple tweaks to NPC AI and animations
- Rewrote the audio system for performance needs
- Added a loading screen to load tracks on boot to prevent hang-ups during play
- General fixes

notes.title: Cubic Neon Nightclub v1.2.0 Update!
notes.notes:
Welcome to version 1.2.0!


 Added AI navigation for NPCs
 Added behaviour tree AI to most NPCs: they can now go to the bar and buy a drink, among other behaviours
 The bartender makes drinks for NPCs with new bar logic
 Dancers can go to randomized locations on the dancefloor
 Added better quality animations across the board
 You can now offer and give drinks to two specific NPCs
 Added a few more stage light patterns
 Strippers have added animations and AI
 Functionality to the Valve Index Knuckles controllers
 Changed the way the player teleports into the club triggering a scene change
 Expanded the stripper area slightly so it’s not as cramped
 Other minor fixes…


Enjoy!
